title: Doppler-Time Intensity Scope
text: Doppler-time intensity scope, 1 input, no direct feedthrough; {Doppler Output} sets the doppler output domain, {Propagation Speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Doppler Offset (Hz)} sets the doppler axis offset, {Time Span (s)} sets the time span of display, {Operating Frequency (Hz)} sets the operating frequency 300e6, {Doppler Resolution (Hz)} sets the doppler interval between samples, {Time Resolution (s)} sets the time difference between rows, {Show Grid} shows Cartesian grid overlay, {Show Ticks} shows tick value labels, {Time Label} sets the time axis label, {Colorbar Label} and {Title} sets the window title. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input data real-valued length- M vector

params.name: Propagation Speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst("LightSpeed") (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Time Span (s)
params.values: Time span of display 0.100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Doppler Resolution (Hz)
params.values: Doppler interval between samples 1.0 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Time Resolution (s)
params.values: Time difference between rows 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Show Grid
params.values: Show Cartesian grid overlay on (default) | off

params.name: Show Ticks
params.values: Show tick value labels on (default) | off
